name: plugin-tour
description: botference Discuss product tour — the whole edit is text: footage/ + edit.json + src/

scripts.audio: ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostats -i out/plugin-tour.mp4 -map 0:a:0 -af loudnorm=print_format=summary -f null - 2>&1 | grep -E "Input (Integrated|True Peak|LRA)"
scripts.capture: node capture/qr.mjs && node capture/braid.mjs && node capture/note.mjs && node capture/capture.mjs
scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/plugin-tour-raw.mp4 -i out/score.wav -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -level 4.1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 22 -preset slow -x264-params keyint=60:min-keyint=60:scenecut=0 -r 30 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -ac 2 -movflags +faststart -shortest out/plugin-tour.mp4
scripts.freeze: ffmpeg -v info -i out/plugin-tour.mp4 -vf freezedetect=n=-55dB:d=2 -map 0:v:0 -f null - 2>&1 | grep -i freeze || echo 'no dead air over 2s'
scripts.loop: remotion render src/index.ts SiteLoop out/site-loop-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --concurrency=8 && npm run loop:encode
scripts.loop:encode: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/site-loop-raw.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 27 -preset slow -r 30 -movflags +faststart out/site-loop.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/site-loop-raw.mp4 -an -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 41 -b:v 0 -row-mt 1 -deadline good -cpu-used 2 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 out/site-loop.webm && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -ss 0.50 -i out/site-loop-raw.mp4 -frames:v 1 -q:v 3 out/site-loop-poster.jpg
scripts.render: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts PluginTour out/plugin-tour-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --concurrency=8 && npm run encode
scripts.verify: npm run frames && npm run verify:qr && npm run freeze && npm run audio
